summary: All 11 backend pytest cases PASS and 17 frontend Playwright assertions PASS. The new /history route, the Pro live feedback panel, and the in-app cancel-confirm Modal are all wired correctly end-to-end. Backend CancelSub schema is now correctly {user_id} only (no plan field) and the route works with the new payload as well as gracefully accepting a stray 'plan' (Pydantic ignores extras → 200). Frontend: header on main shows BOTH open-history-btn (clock) and open-settings-btn (gear). /history loads with 'Ride History' title, three-stat row (Rides/Minutes/Top km/h), session row testID=session-{id} when sessions exist, and 'No rides yet' empty state with speedometer-outline icon when none. history-back-btn returns to main. pro-feedback-panel correctly hidden for FREE users (even when active), hidden for PRO when inactive, and shown only when (tier==pro AND active==true) — vanishes on STOP. Noise metric shows '—' when ai_noise_detection is OFF and a numeric dB value (sampled ~4s) when ON — verified live (e.g., 49 dB). Cancel-Pro flow: cancel-pro-btn opens cancel-confirm-modal; cancel-keep-btn closes with no change; cancel-confirm-btn calls POST /api/subscription/cancel with {user_id} only, modal closes, sub flips to free, and on returning to main the tier-pill shows FREE (useFocusEffect re-fetch from previous iteration still works).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' and 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated, plus props.pointerEvents deprecated. Cosmetic only — does not break anything. Future polish: migrate to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents.

action_items: Nothing to fix. All requested features verified working.
(Optional) Address deprecated style props (shadow* → boxShadow, textShadow* → textShadow, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents) to silence RN-Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: history.tsx correctly uses useFocusEffect to refetch /api/sessions/{user_id} on every focus and on pull-to-refresh — clean.
Pro live feedback panel is gated by `isPro && active` in app/index.tsx (line 567) — exactly the spec.
settings.tsx now uses a React Native Modal with three testIDs (cancel-confirm-modal / cancel-keep-btn / cancel-confirm-btn) — fully testable on web, fixes the prior Alert.alert limitation.
Backend CancelSub model now takes only user_id — schema is semantically correct.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_flowvolume.py (updated test_cancel for new payload schema; added test_cancel_extra_field_rejected_or_ignored and test_sessions_listing_fields)
seed_data_creation: One session was logged via POST /api/sessions through the live UI flow (start → stop), used to verify both the session-{id} row rendering and the empty-state branch.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All current backend endpoints (root, settings GET/PUT, subscription GET/activate/cancel, sessions POST/GET) are healthy. POST /api/subscription/cancel now requires only {user_id}; do NOT send 'plan'. Frontend testIDs in scope: open-history-btn, open-settings-btn, history-back-btn, session-{id}, pro-feedback-panel, cancel-pro-btn, cancel-confirm-modal, cancel-keep-btn, cancel-confirm-btn. AI noise sampling interval = 4s; allow ~5s wait after starting a session before reading the Noise metric. Reset technique used in tests: read flowvolume_user_id from localStorage, then directly hit /api/subscription/cancel or /activate from inside page.evaluate to set state without UI navigation.
